dogecoin.text: No disrespect intended towards Elon or $Doge. If nothing they've brought a significant amount of attention and capital to the crypto space.

The whole ordeal with Elon, $Doge & $BTC didn't necessarily tell us anything new about any of these entities. It did, however, reinforce the axiom that people blindly following an "idol" will, more often than not, do dumb things. We need teachers and mentors, not idols.
